subject: angol
title: Paying teenagers for housework
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Teenagers should be paid for doing household chores
candidateIdeas: Helping at home is part of being a member of a family, not a job.
Paying for chores teaches children to help only when there is a reward.
Responsibility and independence are more valuable lessons than money.
Teenagers can learn to manage money through pocket money or a real part-time job instead.
Payment may cause conflicts between siblings and make the family feel like a business.
examinerArguments: Getting paid motivates teenagers to do jobs they would otherwise avoid.
Earning money at home teaches the value of work and how to manage money.
Adults are paid for their work, so why shouldn't teenagers be?
It is safer for teenagers to earn money at home than in a part-time job.
Paying for extra jobs, like washing the car, is fair because it takes time away from studying or friends.
Many families already do this, and it works well for them.

followUpQuestions: But if parents pay for chores, teenagers learn that work has value. Isn't that a good lesson?
Adults are paid for their work. Why should teenagers work for free?
What would you suggest instead to motivate teenagers to help at home?

usefulPhrases.en: That may be true in some cases; however, ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Ez bizonyos esetekben igaz lehet, azonban ...

usefulPhrases.en: Let me give you an example.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Let's discuss this statement: 'Teenagers should be paid for doing household chores.' What's your view?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'm against it. Helping at home is simply part of being a member of a family – it's not a job. My parents don't get paid for cooking dinner or doing the washing, so why should I get money for tidying my own room? I'm also afraid that paying for chores teaches children to help only when there's a reward.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: But if parents pay for chores, teenagers learn that work has value. Isn't that a good lesson?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It's an important lesson, I agree, but there are better ways to learn it. Teenagers can learn to manage money through regular pocket money, or by getting a real summer job, where they also learn to deal with a boss and deadlines.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Adults are paid for their work. Why should teenagers work for free?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Because the family isn't a company. If everything had a price, home would start to feel like a business, and it could easily lead to arguments between siblings about who earns more. Besides, teenagers aren't working for free: their parents give them food, a home and a lot more.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What would you suggest instead to motivate teenagers to help at home?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think responsibility works better than money. In our family, for example, each of us is in charge of something, and we agree on it together. I suppose a small reward is acceptable for really big extra jobs, like painting the fence, but everyday chores should just be part of family life.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: az álláspont (a fizetés ellen) végig egyértelmű, a vizsgázó saját családjából hoz példát, mindhárom ellenvetésre reagál (elismeri, hogy a munka értékét fontos megtanulni, de jobb módot javasol), a végén pedig részleges engedménnyel (nagyobb extra munkák) kompromisszumot keres.

Szókincs: a családi élet és a pénz pontos szavai (household chores, pocket money, siblings, in charge of) és természetes vitafordulatok (It's an important lesson, I agree, but …; Besides; I suppose …).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos és hibátlan szerkezetek – második feltételes mondat (If everything had a price, home would start to feel …), szenvedő szerkezet (don't get paid), 'teach sb to', a 'why should I …?' kérdés és a 'could easily lead to'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „it's not a job”, „there are better ways to learn it”, „the family isn't a company”, „is in charge of something”.
